headline: the last dance climbs to third on ARC-3

sections.text: the last dance 🕺 gained 6.21 points to reach 49.85, moving from 5th to 3rd on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The climb places the team among the three highest-scoring entries; public standings remain provisional.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
